goal_objective: Diagnose and generically repair the bounded prompt architecture and test controller, then continue through frozen candidate revisions until the same final architecture completes two consecutive full three-configuration matrices with fresh test-taker tasks and zero subject failures, zero missing cells, and valid durable terminals.
failure_classification: PromptCapsule ambiguity or excessive instruction load

evidence_driven_diagnosis.shared_transition: All three paths passed every preceding decision and edge cell and failed at the first Topic-A tension-classification boundary they reached.
evidence_driven_diagnosis.oracle_defect: The provider-visible schema offers supported_unresolved_tension, resolved_difference, and unsupported_claim, but expected_tension emits only supported_unresolved_tension for selected IDs and unsupported_claim otherwise; resolved_difference has no positive frozen semantic oracle cell.
evidence_driven_diagnosis.context_defect: Topic-A tension rendering discards relevant typed predecessor decision and edge results. A-T01 also omits A-S12, the only admitted frozen record explicitly stating one assigned worker, zero mandatory hidden gate-model calls, and pending compile reconciliation.
evidence_driven_diagnosis.route_inference: The identical A-T03 prompt produced the identical wrong value on gpt-5.4-mini xhigh and medium; the defect is not demonstrated to be effort-specific. Luna failed independently at adjacent A-T01 under the same overloaded taxonomy.
evidence_driven_diagnosis.transport_influence: None observed. Every failing call had one final output_text, no prohibited activity, valid capture custody, and NOT_APPLIED_SINGLE_FINAL normalization.

smallest_next_revision.scope: Replace only the model-owned ternary tension stage; preserve decisions, edges, transport, capture, scoring custody, downstream projection, frozen snapshot, and qualification rules.
decomposition: Split each material candidate claim into one binary supported boolean call with exact source closure.
Only after every claim is supported, ask one binary material_boundary boolean call for genuinely ambiguous unresolved authority, scope, sequence, or reconciliation status.

Deterministically reduce any unsupported claim to unsupported_claim, all-supported plus material_boundary true to supported_unresolved_tension, and all-supported plus material_boundary false to resolved_difference.
context_rules: Carry exact typed predecessor facts and their bound source records into declared semantic units.
Require complete material-claim span coverage and exact source union before dispatch.
Reject missing, duplicate, extra, uncovered, or source-omitting units mechanically.
anti_overfit: No A-T01, A-T03, model, route, slot, or frozen-answer branches.
No selected-tension scorer rows or expected payloads in provider-visible bytes.
Use renamed/reordered IDs, all three derived outcomes, source permutations, authority-lineage contrasts, unsupported final clauses, and domain-distinct resolved_difference holdouts before launch.
smallest_next_revision.retest: Freeze a new candidate and run a full fresh three-route matrix because the tension schedule, prompts, response schemas, and downstream eligibility change.
